principles.statement: Acceptance is a run against the real thing (real adb and emulator, real Chrome and UI, real host, real farm/VPS). A mock proves only your reading of the API. When the real substrate is absent, report SKIP with the reason — never fake a pass.
principles.rationale: Operator ruling 2026-10-29. Mock farm 20/20 was not acceptance; android selftest reported 17 pass + 1 SKIP with no device, then 22/22 after a real emulator was provisioned and booted (KVM, ~65 s).

heuristics.name: Real substrate unavailable
heuristics.description: Record SKIP with the exact missing prerequisite and the step to provide it; provision it (user-space where possible) and re-run before claiming done.

decision_rules.condition: A mock is the only thing available
decision_rules.action: Label it contract-only in the test name, the doc and the handoff; schedule the real run.
